headline: Brazil Pulp Producer Suzano Posts 6% Profit Increase in Third Quarter
summary: Brazilian pulp manufacturer Suzano reported a third-quarter profit of approximately $379 million, up 6%, driven by a 36% increase in revenue from its new tissue division.
why: Suzano is a dominant global player in the pulp and paper industry, making its financial results a key indicator for global commodity supply and forestry sector health.
